task.title: Link the desktop download from the site
task.description:
The install section of `site/index.html` gains the desktop app beside Homebrew: a download link per platform at the rolling `desktop-latest` release (`https://github.com/dgoings/workbook/releases/download/desktop-latest/Workbench-<arch>.<ext>`), the note that macOS builds are not notarized and need right-click Open on first launch, and a sentence that installing the app installs the CLI.

The links are stable because installer names carry no version and the rolling release is refreshed on every desktop release; nothing on the site needs editing per release.

Waits for the first desktop release, so it depends on the publish task.

comments.author: a@example.com
comments.body: PR 141 on GitHub (dgoings/workbook): a Desktop app row at the top of the install grid with eight links at the rolling desktop-latest release, plus the bundled-CLI and right-click Open notes. Links 404 until the first desktop release is cut.
